name: implement-and-review
description: Plan, approve, implement, check, review, and allow one bounded repair pass.

stages.task: Make a concrete, read-only implementation plan for this request: {input}. Name files, risks, and the cheapest checks.

stages.message:
The next stages may edit the working tree. Review the plan and approve mutation only if the scope is correct:
{handoff}

stages.task:
Review the implementation and current diff read-only. If concrete issues remain, start the response with ACTIONABLE FINDINGS; otherwise start with CLEAN. Look for correctness, regressions, security issues, and missing checks.
{handoff}

Repair only the concrete failures from the check/review handoff. Do not broaden scope.
{handoff}

Re-review the bounded repair read-only and report remaining actionable findings.
{handoff}
